coreMemory.english: n. the power or skill to do something
coreMemory.structure: ability to do /əˈbɪləti ˈtuː ˈduː/（做某事的能力）；develop an ability /dɪˈvɛləp ˈæn əˈbɪləti/（培养能力）；natural ability /ˈnætʃɚəl əˈbɪləti/（天生能力）；academic ability /ˌækəˈdɛmɪk əˈbɪləti/（学术能力）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use ability with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of ability in context；❌ translate ability word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “ability to do something”

commonErrors.wrong: use ability with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈjuːs əˈbɪləti ˈwɪð ðə ˈseɪm ˈɑrtəkəl ɪn ˈɛvɚiː ˈkɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of ability in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈtʃɛk ðə countability ˈʌv əˈbɪləti ɪn ˈkɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “ability to do something”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈlɝːn ðə kəˈmpliːt ˈfreɪz əˈbɪləti ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。

coreMemory.derivatives: 本词暂无需额外强记的高频派生词
coreMemory.example: Practice improves your ability to recall words.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 练习会提高你回忆单词的能力。

meanings.english: the power or skill to do something
meanings.example: Practice improves your ability to recall words.
meanings.translation: 练习会提高你回忆单词的能力。

items.phrase: to the best of your ability

fixedPhrases.example: Her ability to explain complex ideas is impressive.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她解释复杂想法的能力令人印象深刻。

fixedPhrases.example: Regular practice can develop your ability to speak naturally.
fixedPhrases.translation: 规律练习可以培养你自然表达的能力。

fixedPhrases.example: He has a natural ability to remember names.
The school tests each student’s academic ability.
fixedPhrases.translation: 学校会测试每位学生的学术能力。

fixedPhrases.phrase: to the best of your ability
fixedPhrases.example: I answered the questions to the best of my ability.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我尽自己最大能力回答了这些问题。

fixedPhrases.example: Repairing the machine is beyond my ability.
fixedPhrases.translation: 修理这台机器超出了我的能力。

synonyms.difference: ability 是本卡核心搭配 “ability to do something” 中的中性常用选择；skill 含义接近，但语体、宾语范围和固定搭配可能不同，不能机械互换。

antonyms.usage: 在本卡核心义下与 ability 构成最直接的语义对比；实际使用前仍要核对词性和句型。
